subject.title: fix(workspaces): reject raw file binding pointers

question: Should Markdown and CSV bindings fail closed for every non-root JSON pointer even though existing bindings may currently receive the full file successfully?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and fixes an unsafe semantic fallback, but it deliberately converts an existing successful runtime result into an error without migration or deprecation evidence.

options.title: Accept strict pointer semantics
options.body: Treat non-root pointers on raw-text files as invalid lookups, refresh the branch, and merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Preserve the fallback temporarily
options.body: Keep full-file reads for raw-text pointers until a documented deprecation or compatibility plan is available.

recommendation.title: Accept strict pointer semantics
recommendation.body: Treat non-root pointers on raw-text files as invalid lookups, refresh the branch, and merge after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice concerns the repository-wide binding and validation contract rather than a mechanical implementation detail.
